# O.A.S.I.S.

> Local-first AI assistant for Windows 10/11 x64. Public beta v0.2.0.

## Product

O.A.S.I.S. runs compatible GGUF models locally and adds chat, voice, memory, documents, everyday PC tools and explicit permissions. The Personal edition is free and does not require an account. The application is proprietary; this public repository contains releases, documentation and transparency material, not application source code.

## Capabilities

- Local chat with compatible GGUF models
- Spanish and English voice input/output
- Basic local memory and document workflows
- Everyday low-risk PC control
- Up to three Personal projects
- 100+ registered product tools, with 10 high-impact tools requiring confirmation
- Max-only or planned: vision, advanced RAG, full coding agent, Docker sandbox, workflows, scheduled workflows, messaging, mobile/browser companions, MCP servers, voice cloning, encrypted sync, OpenCode integration and parallel sessions

## Network model

Local features run on your PC. Network-enabled features communicate externally only when you use or configure them. O.A.S.I.S. is offline-first, not network-blind. Web search, online pages, weather, translation fallbacks, Spotify, messaging, companions and external MCP servers can require network access.

## Models

Compatible GGUF models are supported. Bundled profiles include `gemma-4b-it`, `qwen-2.5-1.5b` and `llama-3.2-3b`. Compatibility depends on model, quantization, context size, backend and hardware.
